title: Inhlanzi Nesipho
description: Ngolunye uLwesihlanu olukhethekile, ubaba kaYusuf uyagqoka ngaphambi kokuba kube nokukhanya okukhanyisa isibhakabhaka. Amehlo kaYusuf ayakhanya ngesikhathi uBaba ethi, “Lolu usuku lapho ngizobamba khona inhlanzi bese futhi ngiza nesipho sakho ekhaya.”

usagePolicy.reason: The complete illustrated edition and editable source files remain at Book Dash; this local entry preserves discovery and creator attribution.
